observations: At 320px, each viewport measured 272px and each hint measured 48x48px; content widths were 672, 829 and 848px.
Tabs: reveal and ArrowRight moved focus without selection; Space selected the focused tab. Tab then focused the reveal control, with its white border visible.
Operation hints: reveal focused the next hint without review; explicit Enter dispatched review.
Citations: reveal dispatched horizontal=true and vertical=false to the real local locating helper, without opening or expanding a source.
Candidate-to-original-to-candidate retained observed offsets [257,138,129], selection and callback log.
At 240px, each viewport measured 192px and each hint remained 48x48px. At 900px, viewport/content measured 900px and the hint/48px slot was absent.
Tabs reached x=400 with the last item aligned and the hint hidden/disabled; focus remained on the final tab. This was an instantaneous observation, not a long-duration stability claim.

openFindings.detail: At citation end x=576, the hint was hidden/disabled, but focus fell to BODY rather than the viewport. Reproduced with original and candidate appearances. Full-application impact is unverified.

One later observation moved x=576 to x=528 and redisplayed the hint. Subsequent original/candidate endpoint observations stayed at 576. Root cause remains unproven; the earlier observation is not erased.

Unit RED003: 13 pass/2 expected appearance failures after bounded test corrections; normal exit.
